jobs.title: ORC Investigator - Field-Driven Loss Prevention Pro
jobs.description:
A leading security firm in Dallas, Texas, is seeking an Organized Retail Crime (ORC) Investigator to monitor theft incidents and collaborate with law enforcement. The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of experience in loss prevention or law enforcement investigation.

Responsibilities include conducting surveillance, developing partnerships with agencies, and reporting on theft trends. A high school diploma is required, while a bachelor’s degree is preferred. The role demands professionalism and offers a fast-paced work environment.
